changes.reason: Share the musical controller with selectable SIMD audio; preserve WebGPU behavior while SIMD gains original pixel characters and skins, a seventh Noise performer, cached independent song sections, a sidebar-free compact knob deck with independent Dance/Controls views, single per-voice/part level controls, per-lane Steps, rendered stem meters, beat-preserving tempo/transport handoffs, four directly editable drum hit/volume rows with gesture undo, compact piano-roll views with dedicated scrollbars, native per-row drum mute/solo controls with silenced-row feedback, and correct single-step drag endpoints. Exact reversals retain the original relocation proof.
